sources.primary_title: Usetech to Showcase Its Operational Technology Portfolio at LEAP 2026 in Riyadh
sources.verified_angle_summary: Usetech announced it will showcase its operational technology portfolio at LEAP 2026 in Riyadh. The company will present key products and integrated solutions aimed at organizations developing digital infrastructure, managing operations, and applying AI across industrial and urban environments. Key highlights include 'Launch', an AI-powered platform for multimodal data analytics; 'Octopus', a universal platform for AI-based IT resource optimization in data centers; 'Teal HR', an employee motivation platform; 'Smart City', a solution for civilian policing and critical infrastructure protection; and 'Smart Manufacturing', an end-to-end portfolio for connecting machines and systems. This announcement provides a distinct operational technology angle for LEAP 2026.
